theme_list.name: Antiphon · 对经
theme_list.intro: Archival paper, soot ink and a terracotta seal. Eleven locales across CJK, Latin, Cyrillic and Arabic scripts, with per-script typography and full RTL mirroring, feathered sheet edges, a near-black dark mode with warm accents, a WebGL window light, an institutional ledger layout and a masthead typeface preset picker, plus a restrained motion layer: rows that settle into place, hairlines that fill on hover, and a scan sweep across the masthead.
theme_list.author: AvrovaDonz2026
